steps.expected: The new row shows Target: No target; the editor has Display name, Description, and Target turnaround, and no Target or Slug control; the Description persists after reload.
steps.actual: Add request type with Enter created "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Contract form mu4eht6p", "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Matter form mu4eht6p" and "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p". The list row reads "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Contract form mu4eht6p Target: No target Form fields: 0 fields". Editor labels ["Display name","Description","Target turnaround (business days)"]; Target controls 0, Slug controls 0.

steps.action: Publish an estimated turnaround: 36501 is refused, 5 saves on leaving the control
steps.expected: 36501 shows an error and is not saved; 5 is saved and persists after reload.
steps.actual: The control note reads "Counts Monday–Friday from submission in the organization’s timezone, without excluding public holidays, for Legal to confirm. Blank means no suggestion; saved Request estimates stay unchanged.". 36501 with Tab showed "Enter a whole number from 0 to 36,500 business days, or leave it blank.". 5 with Enter saved; after reload the value is "5". The Matter form was set to 0.

steps.action: Choose the form fields, steps 1-3: Attach field, Required, reorder with the arrow keys; No target offers only Global Fields; the fixed basics; a User Field cannot be required, an Entity Field can
steps.expected: The No target menu lists only Global Fields; Required persists; the order changes; Department is a required basic; the User Field's Required is refused; the Entity Field's Required saves.
steps.actual: No target menu: 8 items, all "· global" (["Region Single select · global","Counterparty name Text · global","Needed by Date · global","Deal value (USD) Number · global"]...). Basics: ["Title required: true","Description required: true","Attachments required: false","Department required: true","Urgency required: true"]. Attached Deal value (USD), Country and Needed by; Required on Deal value (USD); ArrowUp on Needed by; after reload the order is ["Deal value (USD)","Needed by","Country"] and Deal value (USD) is still required. Seeded menus (read only, no change): {"Vendor onboarding (Contract · Vendor)":{"global":4,"moduleScoped":["Governing law Text","Jurisdiction Text","Our position Single select","Security review Single select","Processes personal data Boolean","Liability cap Text","Territories Multi select","Deal desk reference Text","Signed copy filed on Date"]},"Employment question (Matter · Employment)":{"global":7,"moduleScoped":["External counsel Text","Budget approved Number","Budget currency Currency","Regulator Single select"]}}. A requester cannot pick a person in the Portal."; after reload it is not required.

steps.action: Offer guidance before submission, steps 1-4: Deflection links > Add link with an External address (refuse an address without https://) and with a Knowledge item; Placement on each form; Edit; reorder
steps.expected: An address without http:// or https:// is refused; both links save with the chosen placement; Edit changes the label; a handle moves with the arrow keys.
steps.actual: Address "example.com/doc-029-supplier-checklist" was refused with "Enter a full web address that starts with http:// or https://."; with https:// the external link saved. Knowledge item offered 10 items; "How to ask legal for help" saved. Edit changed the Knowledge link label to "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Ask Legal guidance mu4eht6p". Rows: "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Supplier checklist mu4eht6p example.com/doc-029-supplier-checklist Placement: DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Contract form mu4eht6p"; "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Ask Legal guidance mu4eht6p How to ask legal for help Placement: DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Matter form mu4eht6p". ArrowUp moved the Knowledge link from position 7 to 6, kept after reload.

steps.action: Check the result on the Portal: request-type cards, Before you submit, Fields, order, and required markers; submit with a required answer missing, then with valid answers
steps.expected: Both cards show the description and estimated turnaround; each form shows its own guidance; Fields appear in the configured order with required markers; a missing required answer is refused; valid answers create a Request.
steps.actual: Portal cards: "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Contract form mu4eht6p Estimated turnaround: 5 business days Use this DOC-029 form for a supplier contract review."; "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Matter form mu4eht6p Estimated turnaround: 0 business days Use this DOC-029 form for supplier advice that is not a contract.". "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Contract form mu4eht6p" opened /portal/new/doc_029r2_admin_config_compat_contract_form_mu4eht6p; Before you submit links to https://example.com/doc-029-supplier-checklist (target "_blank"); detail Fields read ["Deal value (USD) (required)","Needed by","Country"]. Submit without Deal value stayed on the form and showed "Deal value (USD) is required.". With 125000 and Country "United Kingdom", Submit showed "Request R-16 is with Legal". Following the Knowledge link opened /portal/knowledge/01a0ab53-2a5c-75bb-92fc-82f6cea83646 with heading "How to ask legal for help".

steps.action: Submit the Matter form with a valid Entity answer
steps.expected: A Request is created.
steps.actual: Submitted "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Supplier advice request mu4eht6p" with Urgency High and Entity "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Portal supplier mu4eht6p"; the confirmation reads "Request R-17 is with Legal".

steps.action: Have Legal convert the Contract Request: a blank Type is refused; the attached Field carries; the answer the destination type does not attach is listed under Does not carry into the contract
steps.expected: Convert without a type shows Pick a contract type.; with the Contract type chosen, Deal value (USD) carries, Counterparty name is listed as not carrying, and the Contract is created with the value.
steps.actual: The Convert dialog opened with Contract type "Type…". Convert without a type showed "Pick a contract type." and stayed open. With "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Forms MSA mu4eht6p" chosen the dialog read "Does not carry into the contract Country Deal value (USD) Documents Attach documents or drag and drop files here Convert to matter instead Cancel Convert to contract"; Country is not attached to that Contract type. steps.action: If a configured destination type is archived, select a live type during conversion (fixture: the Target set through the API, because the editor has no Target control)
steps.expected: The Target column names the configured Contract type; after that type is archived, conversion does not use it or switch module; a live type must be chosen and the Request becomes a Contract of that type.
steps.actual: PATCH /api/v1/request-types/<id> set the Target (200); the list row then read "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p DOC-029 form bound to a Contract type that will be archived. Target: Contract · DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Target to archive mu4eht6p Form fields: 0 fields". Jonas Weber submitted R-20. The Target Contract type was archived. The Request Overview read "Requester JW Jonas Weber Type DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p Converts to Contract Department Sales Urgency Medium Submitted this minute". Convert to contract opened with Contract type "Type…"; the archived type was not offered. Convert without a type showed "Pick a contract type.". With "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Forms MSA mu4eht6p" chosen, R-20 became C-51 of that type, not a Matter. The fixture type was restored afterwards.

steps.action: Archive a request type: the dialog reports no usage and no replacement; the Portal drops the card and the form; the Request stays readable; Show archived > Restore offers it again
steps.expected: Archive removes the card and form from the Portal; the earlier Request still opens for the Requester; Restore brings the card back.
steps.actual: Jonas Weber submitted R-21 on "DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p" (/portal/new/doc_029r2_admin_config_compat_archived_target_form_mu4eht6p). The Archive dialog read "Archive DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p DOC-029r2 admin-config compat Archived target form mu4eht6p is not used by any requests — it can be archived without reassignment. Reassign requests to " ; its 1 reassignment select(s) are disabled (0 enabled), although R-21 and an earlier converted Request name this type. After Archive the Portal home had no card for it (seen on load 1 of up to 10, 2 seconds apart), and /portal/new/doc_029r2_admin_config_compat_archived_target_form_mu4eht6p sent the browser to /portal. /portal/requests/21 still showed the Request title. Show archived > Restore brought the card back (1).

steps.actual: Check did not complete: Knowledge Item no longer opens
